text: In the last thirty seconds, twenty new liquidity pools opened on-chain. Each one... a new chart.
Chase them all, and research turns into noise.
Gecko Terminal, from the team behind Coin Gecko, tracks on-chain markets in real time. Prices, pools, trades and liquidity, across more than two hundred networks.
So, a real example. We compared twenty trending pools, and chose one to study.
Claudia, on Solana. Up fifty-nine percent in twenty-four hours. Yet down eighteen, over six. Same pool. Two stories.
Three million dollars traded, against four hundred and fifty thousand in liquidity. Intense activity. Not, by itself, strength.
More buy transactions than sells. But buyers and sellers? Almost exactly even. Count wallets, not clicks.
G T Score, eighty-nine. Mint and freeze authority, disabled. Useful context. Never a guarantee.
But one look is just a snapshot. Research is a routine. Add the pool to your Watchlist. Build lists for the narratives you follow. And start each day with one question. What changed?
Away from your desk, the Gecko Terminal app keeps those markets close.
Stop checking random charts. Build your own on-chain research routine.
